steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Is it over? Did we win?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: Good, at least you can still feel your arm.

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: Now get up if you're still alive.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Ouch! Take it easy, Charles!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Enough fooling around. Harold has enough work to do without you adding to it.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Get to the lakeside if you can still walk. Patch yourselves up if you can.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: I need a few volunteers to help me carry the ones that can't get up themselves.

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: I'll come with you, Jefferson.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Just say it if you don't want that leg of yours anymore. We can have Harold make one for you.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: God's wounds, I can't believe everyone's still breathing after all that. What a bloody miracle.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Could it really be Kjeragandr's protection?

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: Isn't it the other way round? A thousand against one, and she's still breathing...

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Maybe it really is Kjeragandr's protection.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's not.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjeragandr is kind and watchful, but this result is not the result of Her power.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That no one lost their life here is a miracle that we created together.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That's what I believe.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Y-You're the Saintess of Kjerag?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Your words honor us more than we deserve.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: What are your instructions?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I wouldn't call it instructions, per se.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Just an invitation to attend the post-ceremony banquet, as is the place of the host.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: After all, aren't you here in Kjerag for the ceremony?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: ...I thought exile would be the best-case scenario.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: We're allowed to participate in the banquet?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Would you rather be here for the banquet, or admit that you're here for a 'military operation' and go to prison?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Uhm.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Go on, be my guest.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Everything is ready. The banquet can begin at any tie.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thank you, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Why thank me?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No particular reason... just wanted to thank you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjerag will become a better place, Kjarr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There will come a day when people from the outside will know more than just Karlan Trade, see more than just the snow, mountains and valleys.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They will know that there is a country here by the name of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A respectable country with its unique culture and customs, where its people live in prosperity.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Sounds great.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You sure you don't need 'a little help', Enya?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Without that, you wouldn't have any rainbows.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjeragandr's blessing reaches into the heart because of how precious it is.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If we ask Kjeragandr for a miracle for every little thing, then what's left is not religion, but reliance.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When you start to take something for granted, that's when you stop respecting it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Things are fine the way it is.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let's just hope Kjeragandr doesn't get angry at me for thinking this way.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hah, don't worry, Enya.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Nothing makes a mother happier than to see her child start to walk on its own two feet.

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: I'm done, Mr. Silverash.

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: This is my first outdoor speech. Are you sure this is going to work?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It was perfect, Mr. Mob.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Your voice was filled with passion. No one could pick a flaw in it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Even though you declined my offer to have someone magnify your voice with Originium Arts, the amplification device that you used performed above and beyond expectations.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is this your company's new product?

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: This amplifier?

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: No, of course not. It's good, but the market for amplifiers is cornered by a few big companies. There's no place for us there... ahem. Forget I said anything.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've heard about corporate competition in Kazimierz. You didn't say anything that I didn't know.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, what is it that you're using?

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: A gift from a friend I met on the train.

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: They probably thought it was just a toy.

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: Who could have thought that it would come in so handy when Mr. Silverash made that abrupt request?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Mr. Mob, Karlan Trade would very much love for our cooperation to extend beyond this one time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will have someone take you around Kjerag for the next few days, including tours of our mines and factories.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Please accept this as a token of my sincerity.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I believe Kjerag will not disappoint you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: They stopped. They really stopped.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's like you said. That man in a suit opens his mouth, and both sides stop fighting before long!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I thought we were in for a real fight. Didn't SilverAsh tell you guys to get here quick?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But it was all over in an instant.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why did the Victorians and Kjerags stop fighting as soon as he arrived?

options: Because he's a spokesman for the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who...? Is that really important?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, wait, I know!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The important thing is that he's from Kazimierz, isn't it?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Victoria wants to bully Kjerag for its own interests, but they have to be careful when it comes to Kazimierz, who's also here for its own interests... I think something like this came up in one of Anna's tests.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So... is this why SilverAsh contacted you and Muelsyse?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're his backup plan?

options: You're learning, Leto.
We don't need it now, though.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No wonder you were in such a hurry.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Stuff like this is a pain.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But how did you know that the man in the suit was a spokesman for... hm, for what again?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You know him?

options: We've met.
His appearance has changed, but his voice hasn't.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh yeah, you and Amiya went to Kazimierz for a while.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I want to go with Mamochka, if I get the chance.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: There are a few knights I really like. They're so cool!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Appearance... voice?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I guess his voice was pretty unusual. It was really loud.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't know how he did it. I could hear him all the way from here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh yeah, Doctor.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Did you give him something at the station?

options: A little toy that Closure made.
Just a little help.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Somehow, I can't help but think there's more than meets the eye.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh... Muelsyse is chatting with someone.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Should we go over?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You have people you know here too, don't you, Sharp?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I'm working right now.

options: The one who invited me is probably a little too busy right now.
Taking in the view here isn't such a bad idea.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll stay with you.

options: I don't think that's going to work.
There's someone waiting for you there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: For me? Who? Oh...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: HIM.

options: Are you not going?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, there really isn't anything I want to say to him..

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Arrggghhh! This sucks!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sorry, Doctor, Sharp, give me a minute!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll be back soon!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You got something to say, spit it out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Otherwise, I've got places to be.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I just wanted to make sure that you're safe.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I couldn't come find you in that chaos.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The Victorians weren't looking for me. Even that Trilby Asher guy is no match for Sharp and the Doctor.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That bastard's still after you?!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't think so. It didn't look like he was here for me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, he's lucky he ran away. Sharp and I would have given him a nice little beating.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't underestimate a Trilby Asher.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't like their methods either, but the Trilby Ashers are a big deal.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Him? Didn't seem like he was anything special.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's because Enciodes has Degenbrecher to keep him down!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: A warrior must never underestimate an enemy, Rosalind.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, you done then? I gotta go.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Three.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Two.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: R-Rosalind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...I spent a lot of time thinking about it last night.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I was weak back then.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The days with your mother were like honey. I couldn't keep myself from thinking about her. I couldn't keep myself away from her, from the very beginning.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I dragged you and Tatyana into that mess, but abandoned you when I couldn't handle the pressure...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You were right to yell at me, Rosalind.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Whatever I say now won't be anything more than an excuse.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: For more than a decade, my memory has tried to justify it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It whitewashes the memories for a man too weak to face his own weaknesses, so that he can continue to feel safe, continue to run away.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He lied so much he even fooled himself.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It's my fault.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I deserve to be scolded and scorned by you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And I can't blame you for being disappointed in me and Kjerag...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I let you and your mother down.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: There's one thing I want to make clear.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka never said anything bad about Kjerag.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Or about my papa.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: She even taught me how to pray to Kjeragandr, even though I never really believed in it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka only ever said good things about this place.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tatyana... she doesn't hate Kjerag?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why would I lie?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I told you, didn't I? She said my papa was really handsome.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Of course, I'm having doubts about that now.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It was before I started in with the beard. Tatyana did say she liked my face...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Wait, why did she tell you all this... could it be...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Could it be that she doesn't blame me?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't get too ahead of yourself.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't count on other people not blaming you, if you know you're wrong.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But it's exhausting to live with hatred. You underestimate Mamochka, if you thought she would spend a decade hating you and Kjerag.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're not worth it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're right...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It's not worth it to live in pain for a man like me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It's all for the better...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Good, you get it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I didn't know who my papa was, and now I do. But that's all there is to it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't need recognition from your family. Paleroche business is none of my business.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm the daughter of Tatyana Yevgenyevna Larina.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina, codename Leto. Remember that.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It was Tatyana who named you. Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina... rolls more smoothly off the tongue than Paleroche.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Leto... not bad, not bad. A nice codename.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: At least you have taste.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh yeah.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: This is for you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: A... bank account?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Child support for all these years. The amount is in the back. I rounded it down for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Please make the transfer at your earliest convenience.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ch-Child support?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I said it yesterday, didn't I?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Living expenses, tuition, medical bills, emotional damages for a deadbeat dad... it's all there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Gotta go.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: W-Wait, Rosalind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The... the currency conversion might take some time. I-I'll find someone to take care of it as soon as possible!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Rosalind!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Please, can I see Tatyana one more time? Just once...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: In your dreams!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Is this your will too, Kjeragandr?

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: The matters of the world are beyond a mere mortal's ability to predict...

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Master?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Why are you standing all the way up front? There's nothing to see in particular...

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Just passing by.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You said you just became a grandfather the last time you came to pray, Lucas?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: My son's daughter. Good thing she looks like her mother.

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: That foreign woman my son insisted on marrying. From what's-the-name... Siracusa! Fierce woman, that.

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Well, at least the kid of mine got a taker.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Were you against the marriage?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: What's the point, if the young ones are in love?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: I might have said a word or two in my younger days.

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: But now? Just let them be.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You said you wanted a warding stone for your granddaughter, didn't you?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Hoping that some of Kjeragandr and the Saintess's blessings would rub off, you know.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: You can have this.

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Th-This mark... it's a stone blessed by the Saintess herself?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: Th-That's too precious for someone like me, Master!

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: Take it. Consider it a welcome gift for your granddaughter as she comes into this world.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: I'll pray to Kjeragandr that the children of Kjerag can grow up without illness, pain, or sorrow.

steps.name: Elder Devotee
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: The Black Knight is definitely more than just a name. To think she wasn't even trying to kill...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: A little too much for old bones like mine.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier?
steps.text: Sir, your injuries...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Just a scratch.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Don't want to miss the Saintess's banquet, after all.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It's not every day that I get to be called 'sir' by you, though.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I think I just lost my appetite, for some reason.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My condolences concerning your appetite, My Lord.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I will report the facts of your performance in Kjerag and the changes in the situation to the Duke.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'm confident that I did nothing to displease Her Grace.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What about you, Trilby Asher?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: The waters of Londinium you could muddle, but Kjerag gives you little room to maneuver.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No need to worry about me, My Lord.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I have complete the mission assigned to me by Her Grace.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Kjerag is not worth devoting too much time and effort to, but there are elements that require the Duke's attention.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: We thought it was Karlan Trade, or Kjerag's geographical advantages as a natural fortress and commerce hub...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Seems like Her Grace is truly grounded... or visionary?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Are you here to visit the true form of Kjeragandr?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Her Grace wants to know whether Kjeragandr truly exists in Kjerag.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: In times of crisis, will Kjeragandr really help Her people?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Interesting.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: And your conclusion?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I do not recommend that the Duke confront Kjerag militarily at this time.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Seeing the Kazimierzian corporations that publicly entered into partnership with Karlan Trade, I also ran into a Columbian scientist on the way here...

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Force is not the smart plan.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Winning is easy, making money is hard. We're not Ursine. It's not worth it.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It's not every day that we agree with each other.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Did you hit your head or something?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Like you, I'm a pacifist.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eww...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Just talk like you normally do. Please.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If it saves some time and effort.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My Lord.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Are you familiar with this little trinket?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: A burdenbeast blind box, they're all the rage right now.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Why would you buy this?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well, that's not important. Open it up and let's see what's inside.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I've got a full set, but I'm missing the limited-edition secret version.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: No one knows what the box holds until it's opened.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The mystery is what makes it alluring. Perhaps I shouldn't open it.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well, are you going to open it or not?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'll have it, if you're not going to open it.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'll open it.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Hm? What's this?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What did you find? Let me see... mother of mercy!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Frozen crystal burdenbeast! Secret limited edition!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What kind of luck is that? I've been opening these boxes since the first day I arrived in Kjerag, and I've never gotten this one!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: By Kjeragandr, this is not fair!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Trilby Asher, we're both in Her Grace's employ. Do you think you could...?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I'm afraid not, My Lord.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I must stay in Kjerag for a while longer after submitting my report.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Thanks to you, I just realized that... collecting burdenbeast accessories isn't such a bad pastime after all.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Can you stand?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Not dead yet. I'll be fine in a few days.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Gnosis?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He went down first.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He says he's footing the bill tonight.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: He has lousy taste. Pick for him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You've been walking around in circles there for ages. You got something to say, out with it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm thinking that my debt to you seems to keep growing, from Kazimierz to here.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: One that I don't see a way to repay.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're afraid I'd jump ship?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It would be a big loss.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You want to repay me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Name your price. Gnosis will find a way.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Forget it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: All I did was follow an arrogant young man to these bleak frozen hills ten years ago on a whim, a place where the temperature hovers around freezing on the warmest days.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Life here didn't turn out to be so bad, so I started doing what I could.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What does any of that have to do with you, Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I guess you're right.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You stayed for the land, not for me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I didn't think I would hear it from your own mouth.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And don't put on that act about owing me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Tell the truth. What are you thinking?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm thinking...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There will come a day when people from the outside will know more than just Karlan Trade, see more than just the snow, mountains and valleys.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They'll remember the name 'Kjerag'.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't get too excited.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You may have won this round, but at the end of the day you've just gotten yourself even more tough customers.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Should I thank you for bringing Kazimierz back to me?
Enciodes stays silent for a moment, then picks up a broken piece of ice from the ground and points it at the sun.
The ice is dauntingly cold, but it glitters under the sun, almost glaringly.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes. Kazimierz has come, Columbia is coming.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Things will only get more complicated.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You can't win every time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Have you ever lost?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's too bad. You must never have met an opponent like me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Come with Gnosis to the Tschäggättä's training grounds. I'll take both of you on at the same time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: One hand tied behind my back.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Haha. Gnosis is actually not bad with a sword.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're in a good mood.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's all done.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Three years of perseverance have borne fruit at last.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We broke things wide open. Caster is no longer an existential threat.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The independence of Kjerag is no longer a pipe dream.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: In order words, you've drawn the attention of both arrogant Victorian nobles and unscrupulous Kazimierz merchants.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Soon to be joined by scientists with no qualms about moral or ethics.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Even more people will hate you for bringing even more chaos to this country.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All I care is—

steps.name: Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Excuse me—

steps.name: Campaign Knight A
steps.text: Are you the Black Knight?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Campaign Knight A
steps.text: So it's true! The Black Knight is in Kjerag!

steps.name: Campaign Knight B
steps.text: It's really the Black Knight! This makes it all worth it!

steps.name: Campaign Knight A
steps.text: And you... you're the president of Karlan Trade, aren't you?

steps.name: Campaign Knight A
steps.text: I've been a fan of the Black Knight since I was five. Can I get her autograph?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's up to her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you want to sign for these young folks, Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Fine.
The campaign knights eagerly call out to their comrades.
A little line forms on the ice.
It is like one of the many small fan meet-and-greets on the streets of Kazimierz.
The campaign knights give Degenbrecher their cards, and Degenbrecher writes her name on them.
Enciodes chats with the knights every now and then, playing the part of a good host.
It is all very natural. No one has the slightest complaint.
Eventually, the knights leave, satisfied, and calm returns to the ice.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The campaign knights I know aren't that excitable.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our partnership with Kazimierz has just begun. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz wouldn't have sent 'real' campaign knights.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is just the Browntails spending their own money to invite some youths over for a sightseeing trip.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And it probably took the Black Knight's name to get them to agree.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Maybe I'm no different from the Kazimierz that you hated. You're just another chip in my hands.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All of it is the same, be it your identity as the Black Knight, Kazimierz's exploitation of you, your martial strength, and your value as a soldier.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you find this unacceptable?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Now?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I've gotten used to it.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let us once again welcome our friends from far away.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The doors of Kjerag are always open to those who come in good faith. Let us remember the friendships forged today.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: By Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: By Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Thank you for the invitation, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You're... Muelsyse, from Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It warms me up that you still remember me.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The mountains and rivers of Kjerag that I saw along the way were awfully pretty. I'm sure we'll have a great partnership.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Rhine Lab's partner is Karlan Trade, Miss Muelsyse.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But you are the one calling the shots in Kjerag.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Building a launch pad on Karlan is a big deal. Mr. Silverash has stressed the need to get the Saintess's blessing.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I have heard about this from Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Karlan is the spine and body of Kjeragandr. I must say I have reservations about such a massive project taking place there—

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: What is it, Kjarr?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: That launch pad that they're talking about, it sends things into the sky, right?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If they build it there...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Does it mean that I...?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Er, Kjeragandr, will get a few cannons on Her body?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Cannons...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr... do you think Kjeragandr would object?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Object? Why?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It sounds so cool!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You should say yes!

steps.name: Beautiful Woman
steps.text: Lisburn! What happened?

steps.name: Beautiful Woman
steps.text: Those wounds...

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: It's nothing.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Freya, I have something important to tell you...

steps.name: Beautiful Woman
steps.text: What is it, Lisburn?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: I... love...

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: 'I ♥ Snow'! The knitted words on your clothes look so nice!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: The snowy mountains are so beautiful on a fine day like this!

steps.name: Beautiful Woman
steps.text: Huh? Oh, uh, yeah.

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: Aw damn it all!

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: The berk ran away from THAT? I should shoot him for desertion!

spans.text: I should shoot him for desertion!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Keep it down, Jack!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Did you all peep on me like this, back in the day, when I proposed to my wife?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Come now, Harold, this isn't personal. We do this to everyone who proposes.

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: Is Lisburn really going to propose after a fight like that?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What does he have to lose after a fight like that?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: She says yes, he gets to bury his bones here. She says no, he gets closure and returns to Victoria. It's going to take him the better part of a full year to recover.

steps.name: Somber Soldier
steps.text: You have a point.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You idiots, why didn't you call me over to help?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Are you going to let your brother propose empty-handed? No ring, fine, but not even a flower?

steps.name: Slippery Soldier
steps.text: It's all ice and snow here. Where are you gonna find a flower?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Make an ice flower, then! What do you carry your weapons for? Nothing shows sincerity like the handmade stuff. That's what the ladies like, don't you understand?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Well, you're in a better position to understand than any of us...

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Right, Harold? Ice flower, eh? I'm sure there's someone back home who will be very interested to know.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: W-Wait! Don't you run your mouth in front of my wife!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I've never given an ice flower to any woman other than Lily... it was just an example! Really!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I didn't expect to see you here.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's my job to protect the Doctor.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Same old story.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Care to spar?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: After you've fully recovered.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: We can do it after hours, if I'm still in Kjerag then.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: How many people do you have who are better than you?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I wouldn't mind making the trip myself, if there are enough of them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You used to commentate the knight competitions?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No wonder your voice sounded familiar. Maybe I watched a match you were covering!

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: Thanks for the compliment. Not that I have much to write home about other than my voice!

steps.name: Spokesman Mob
steps.text: I didn't expect to see the campaign knights here, though...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The ones in silver armor? They're so cool!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I invited them here!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And you, too, Rosalind! You're a guest of mine as well.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Enjoy the hospitality of Kjerag!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must thank you, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thank you for accepting the invitation, and for your little gift to Mr. Mob.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It was quite helpful.

options: You had a plan even without my help, didn't you?
Save it, I know you always have a backup plan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It would have involved more effort.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Under the circumstances, I'm plenty thankful just to speed things up by a step.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I hope you're happy with our hospitality.

options: Don't think you can hook me with an invitation letter next time.
Was it you who invited Rhine? I thought Rhodes Island was the extent of your manipulation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Looks like you still remember our game of chess three years ago, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our relationship has changed over the past three years. There's no need for this level of caution.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Karlan Trade invited Rhine Lab to discuss cooperation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I, Enciodes, invited you, Doctor, for the sole purpose of attending the ceremony, and nothing else.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You can take part of the credit for this festive scene before us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Come, ally.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I will be happy to be your guide, if you would like to see what Kjerag is like now.

options: I guess we could do worse than a shore leave.
I'll be your guest, then, so to speak.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: One more thing.

options: Next time, if you want me to bring someone with me, just say it.
Are you surprised that she didn't come?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As an ally, I'm sure you understand what I mean.

options: Cliffheart is doing fine. It's just that this was on short notice, and she happened to be away from Rhodes Island.
Your sister is busy with her own business. Send the invitation earlier next time.
She'll come back to Kjerag next time.
She said she'll give you a surprise. The plural 'you'.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Glad to hear that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's a shame that she couldn't come on such an important occasion, but if she continues to climb, then whatever peak she reaches...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: She'll hear the wind of Karlan from the top.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Ratatos?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You shouldn't be here now. The absence of the head of one of the three great houses at the Saintess's banquet will draw unnecessary attention.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus will take care of things.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If there's anyone who shouldn't be here at this time, it's the CTO of Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm sure that director of Rhine Lab has many things she wants to discuss with someone in a technical position.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes will take care of her needs.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We want Rhine Lab's technology, and they want Karlan's elevated terrain. Fundamentally, this is a business deal.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's more in Enciodes's domain.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I guess you're right.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm thinking that Enciodes must have had a dozen contingency plans for today's incident.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He put up a good act of being worried, though. Did it fool you?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's the kind of person he is. I'm not surprised.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But there's one thing that you're off the mark about, Ratatos.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This is the rare occasion that he didn't put up an act.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yes... It's not like him. Not sufficiently profit-driven, too much risk, yet the best outcome was achieved for everyone.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You hear that, Gnosis? It's the sound of metal coming together to form a monster.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I've listened to the heavy noise of construction for long enough.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Project One is near completion, from what I've heard.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You heard right.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But for all the effort we committed, even building Kjeragandr's statue as a ruse and building the base underneath Lake Silberneherze...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: For all the time we put in, the effort it took to hide it all—

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: One battleship is all we managed to build.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: We can't hide it for long. Even if Victoria lets it go this once, the world will eventually figure out what we're doing.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's why we don't need to hide it on purpose.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Just try not to draw too much attention.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm sure you realize why Victoria stopped.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We must develop as much as we can now, while all the powers at work are still in balance.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This is the only way out for Kjerag.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I hope it all goes as well as you say.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Speaking of which, Ratatos.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I heard some rumors.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Are you really going to call the Project One ship the 'Walnut'?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That silly sister of mine came up with an interesting idea this time.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: She said that when she has her own kids, she'll tell them that this ship is their older brother.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Cute, isn't it?
Rosalind?
I'm sorry I couldn't come with you to Kjerag this time.
You took the box to the top of the mountain, didn't you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You can trust me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You went out again? The doctor told you to stay in bed!

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Just taking a walk. I'm fine.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: All this fuss over one broken bone. I'm getting suffocated, stuck in a hospital room all day.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's because you weren't careful when fiddling with that jetpack...

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: It was fun, wasn't it?

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I want to try it again sometime. Did you have the chance to try out rock-climbing while you were in Kjerag?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No, I didn't.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: You really should, next time you have a chance. It's fun.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I'll take you on an adventure in Sargon once my leg's healed... Sami sounds good too!

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Tatyana
steps.text: I can't wait!
